title: Original LAYOUT dependencies and source-mode coupling

sources.role: Distinct structural and associated-block330 roles; last active viewport331, named345 and orthographic base346 UCS, absent named UCS and absent base UCS with nonzero original orthographic76.
PlotSettings prefix: plot type74 selects named view6 only in type3; shade mode76 and shade ID333 are distinct from Layout orthographic76.
Official numeric shade enum: VisualStyle4 and RenderPreset5. An API enum is not broad DXF producer/version/native evidence.

VisualStyle/RenderPreset require actual VisualStyle/RenderSettings objects. Setters clear unused IDs in AsDisplayed/Rendered modes. This does not establish foreign nonzero inactive-ID DXF loading semantics, so those carriers remain unqualified.

scope: Admit actual original LAYOUT source bodies as dependency sources, preserve exact reference/scope roles and bind conditional uses to actual original mode fields. Distinguish declarations, target references, inactive fields and derived absence dispositions. Reuse prior original source/body/context/identity certificates; do not promote full recursive/live/emitted/whole-document/native or external semantics.

implementation.admission: Only actual target-provider LayoutAudit bodies with matched original independent profiles/models; pin source owners and physical identity. Census physical LAYOUT objects, including unavailable producers. Structural owner330 and associated BLOCK_RECORD330 remain separate roles; Layout name1 is a declaration and not a reference use.
implementation.modeFacts: Retain actual Plot74, Plot76 and Layout76 values and original group indices separately. Application lookalikes, the other subclass76, live edits and normalized omitted-mode defaults cannot qualify conditional uses. Expose row mode/group metadata.
implementation.modeDispositions: Explicit inactive plot-view name uses are Inactive. Canonical zero shade IDs in explicit modes0/3 are Inactive; nonzero foreign inactive shade carriers remain OriginalUnavailable and unchanged by reading. Actual plotType3 requires name6; actual shadeMode4/5 requires nonzero333. Active VIEW names and VisualStyle/RenderSettings need genuine source providers. Named/base UCS and viewport references retain distinct kinds, null and unavailable dispositions. Missing named UCS is an inherited unnamed disposition; missing base UCS inherits WORLD only with an actual nonzero Layout76.
implementation.bounds: Charge retained layout sources/profiles, enlarged nodes/rows and up to four derived rows per physical identity before work. Configured row/byte/work caps unchanged; logical estimates are not measured RSS. Queries remain allocation-free in controls.

The next tests were mistakenly dispatched before inspecting that build failure and used the old binary. first-tests.log is retained as invalid/stale verification and is not part of final qualification.

development.verifiedDevelopment: After the successful rebuild, second-tests.log passes the prior dependency selector plus the minimal gap control. Expanded matrix passes, then a reviewed guard withholds foreign inactive nonzero shade IDs; final owning matrix passes in3.60s.
